nurse.text: Hello, hello, come in out of that. Lerwick Sanctuary. You look like you've crossed the North Sea on a bad night. Pop the team on the counter.
What can we do for you?

then.text: There's a kettle on and a plate of bannocks. A Shetland bannock is a sort of soft round loaf, if you were wondering. Poor things, they're perished. There. All better.
There you go. Mind the wind on the way out. It has a grudge against hats.
The Ark's in the corner. Have a look. It has a view of Bressay, which is more than I get.

else.text: No bother. If you're here for the fire festival, bring a coat.
